description: This file defines interfaces for grain call filters in the Orleans framework, specifically for incoming and outgoing call filtering.

classes.name: IIncomingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: Interface for incoming grain call filters, providing a method to invoke the filter with a call context.

classes.name: IOutgoingGrainCallFilter
classes.description: Interface for outgoing grain call filters, providing a method to invoke the filter with a call context.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Method to invoke the filter with the specified grain call context.
